summary_en: Omron Healthcare (Omron subsidiary) tender offer for Matsuya R&D (7317, TSE Growth) closed 2026-06-15. Total shares tendered: 18,459,288 ordinary shares plus warrants. Minimum acceptance threshold 11,230,300 shares met; offer completed.
title_en: Notice of Results of Tender Offer by Omron Healthcare Co., Ltd. for Shares and Warrants of Matsuya R&D Co., Ltd. (Securities Code: 7317)
translation_en_brief: On 18 May 2026, Omron Healthcare Co., Ltd. (a subsidiary of Omron Corporation, ticker 6645) resolved to launch a tender offer for Matsuya R&D Co., Ltd. (ticker 7317, listed on TSE Growth market) under the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act. The offer commenced 19 May 2026 and closed successfully on 15 June 2026. The tender offer encompassed ordinary shares (target acquisition 18,459,288 shares) and warrants (first tranche warrants with exercise period 2021-03-29 to 2029-03-28). The minimum acceptance threshold was 11,230,300 ordinary shares; once this floor was met, Omron Healthcare was obligated to acquire all tendered securities. The offer succeeded and was concluded on the closing date.
